journal.wicklen_chronicles.title: Wicklen · Field journal
journal.wicklen_chronicles.conversation_: Your spirit is listening. Ask about the world, or open the Atlas to see your discoveries.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.dialog_unsupp: This server does not support spirit conversations.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.wait: One moment. Try the action again.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.action_unavai: Actions are unavailable while dead or spectating.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.already_activ: Finish your current task and collect its reward first.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.taken: A new task has been added.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.turned_in: Task submitted. Your reward is ready to collect.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.claimed: Reward collected. The completed task is in History.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.inventory_ful: Make room in your inventory. Your reward will keep waiting.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.not_ready: The conditions are not complete. Collection materials must be in your inventory.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.stale: This action is out of date. Refresh the journal.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.action_failed: The action could not be completed. Refresh and try again.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.unavailable: Journal data is unavailable. Ask the server administrator; your saved data is preserved.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.unsupported: This server does not support the field journal.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.timeout: No reply yet. You can refresh and try again.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.empty_connect: Refresh to load your personal journal.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.atlas_empty: Look through a spyglass at a creature or an interesting place. A server-confirmed observation will appear here.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.history_empty: Completed tasks will appear here after you collect their rewards.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.no_active: No active task. Take one from your spirit; progress and rewards are tracked by the server.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.discovery_hin: This is your own discovery. Unexplored places are not revealed by the journal.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.reward_waits: The reward is saved. If your inventory is full, it will wait for you.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.story_need_di: First observe a creature or an interesting place with your spyglass. Its confirmed discovery gives your story a starting point.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.story_finish_: Finish your current task and collect its reward before starting a new story.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.story_empty: Your discoveries can become a story. Ask your spirit for two paths, with a visible goal, reward and consequence.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.story_thinkin: The spirit is considering your discoveries. You can keep playing.
item.wicklen_chronicles.field_notebook.h: Use on a cartography table to bind your field desk. Return after 3 new discoveries for supplies. Sneak-use another table to move it.
field_camp.wicklen_chronicles.bound: Field desk recorded. Return with your notebook after 3 new discoveries.
field_camp.wicklen_chronicles.save_faile: Could not save the field desk. Your progress is preserved; try again later.
field_camp.wicklen_chronicles.move_hint: This is another desk. Sneak-use your notebook to move your field desk here.
field_camp.wicklen_chronicles.progress: New discoveries for the next field kit: %s / %s.
field_camp.wicklen_chronicles.supplied: Field kit received: torches, bread and paper. Your next expedition is ready.
field_camp.wicklen_chronicles.inventory_: Make room in your inventory. Your earned field kit will keep waiting.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.map_hint: You are the green centre. Select a recorded place to inspect it. The grid shows coordinates, not unexplored terrain.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.map_limit: At most 32 nearest known places in this dimension. Adjust the scale for distant records.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.research.read: Field reward ready. Collect it when you have room.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.research.once: One reward per collection, player and world. Repeated scans do not reset it.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.research.clai: Field reward collected. Your completed collection stays recorded.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.research.reje: This field reward is unavailable or already collected.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.camp_hint: A field notebook used on a cartography table creates a home desk for future expedition supplies.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.creature_summ: This species was observed through your spyglass and recorded in your personal atlas.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.discovery_sav: Could not save the observation. Try again in a few seconds.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.encounter.exe: The trial executor is unavailable on this server. No encounter can be started; exploration and stories still work.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.encounter.no_: First find an abandoned waystation and record it with the spyglass. Only a courtyard you have personally studied appears here.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.encounter.pre: Choose a difficulty to prepare. Then press Start to begin.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.encounter.con: Everyone must stand in the courtyard before Start.
Leave: 5 seconds to return. Death or disconnect ends the trial.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.encounter.rew: Victory: one Wayfarer’s Lantern for each participant.
wicklen_chronicles.help.spyglass.action: Hold use on a creature or landmark for 2 s.
wicklen_chronicles.help.spyglass.detail: A target label shows what can be recorded.
wicklen_chronicles.help.notebook.action: Use on a cartography table to set up a desk.
wicklen_chronicles.help.notebook.detail: Return after 3 new discoveries for supplies.
wicklen_chronicles.help.notebook.result: Sneak-use another table to move the desk.
wicklen_chronicles.help.lantern.action: Use: absorption for 20 s, speed for 10 s.
wicklen_chronicles.help.lantern.detail: Reusable. Wait 60 s before using it again.
wicklen_chronicles.help.lantern.result: All copies share the same cooldown.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.scan.no_targe: No recordable target · try a creature, village or ruin.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.scan.recorded: Recorded: %s · open your journal to continue
journal.wicklen_chronicles.journey.obser: Use an ordinary spyglass. Aim at a creature or landmark and hold use for 2 seconds. A scan label confirms the target.
Your record unlocks stories, collection goals and rewards.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.journey.story: A discovery can start a story
Your field notes can lead to a short story. Read two possible tasks and their rewards, then choose what you want to do.
You can keep exploring at your own pace. Trials and collections have their own pages on the left.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.journey.quest: Work towards the objective below. Open the task to see its details.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.journey.submi: Submit the completed task. For a collection task, the required items will be taken from your inventory.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.journey.rewar: Collect your earned reward. If your inventory is full, it stays here until you have room.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.journey.court: Find a place to put your gear to use
Look for an abandoned waystation while exploring. Record its courtyard with the spyglass; it will appear in Trials.
The visible sparkles and scan label help you recognise a place you can record.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.journey.trial: A courtyard is ready for you
Open Trials, go to a recorded courtyard and prepare a Normal encounter. The fight starts only when you press Start.
Victory earns a reusable Wayfarer’s Lantern.
Return to the courtyard and defeat the waves. If you cross the marked boundary, return within 5 seconds.
Your personal reward will wait in Trials after victory.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.journey.battl: Open the completed trial and collect your Wayfarer’s Lantern. A full inventory keeps the reward waiting.
Hold the lantern and use it for temporary protection and speed.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.journey.relic: Take your lantern into the next fight
Hold your earned lantern and use it for protection and speed. Its cooldown is 60 seconds.
When ready, prepare an Empowered trial at a recorded courtyard.
journal.wicklen_chronicles.encounter.ada: Wave composition and strength account for your equipment. The plan is frozen before Start; after setbacks, a trial may become gentler.
